site_name: Land west of Philips Mains, Mey

site_area_m2.notes: Marketed as '20+ hectares'; treated as a minimum. Coordinates are the PlanIt point for EIA screening 20/01258/SCRE, near the MeyGen onshore infrastructure and the consented Gills Bay 132kV substation.

current_land_use: Greenfield land per Invest Highland listing; agricultural coastal land near Mey
land_notes: Owned by Simec Atlantis Energy Ltd (SAE Renewables) per Invest Highland. SAE's Mey BESS (300 MW / 1.2 GWh, s36 application) occupies a 10.7 ha site in the same locality next to the approved Gills Bay substation. Official red-line area (Spatial Hub, planning application boundary): 43.0 ha; previously recorded 20.0 ha (reported); difference +115%. The official red line for screening 20/01258/SCRE encloses ~43.0 ha against ~20 ha reported. Unresolved; both figures retained.
